C5: binary comparison of two empty files (0 bytes)

productDecision.rationale: Delphi off-by-one loop bug in C5Binary.dll: The binary comparison loop is compiled from 'for i := 0 to FileSize do', which executes FileSize + 1 times in Pascal. On the (FileSize + 1)-th iteration, it reads past EOF, raising STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION at address 0x00000000. Delphi catches the exception and returns score 0.0000 with 'Kết quả KHÁC đáp án!'. 0-byte files fail CreateFileMappingW with Win32 error 1006. Product decision: implement the documented byte-for-byte C5 contract and mark the historical DLL defect as intentionally not emulated; never call this exact DLL runtime parity while C5 fixture records differ from the defective DLL behavior.
